entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I bought a jersey a while back and I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not faulty, it's just the wrong size. I saved up for this jersey, and it's just... way too tight. I can't even ride in it comfortably. I feel awful about it.
I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I just really need this to work out. Things are a bit tight financially, and I was counting on this.
I appreciate your loyalty, and I'll do my best to help. Let me see... VF88602. Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 66 days ago.
Oh... is that too long? I really hope not.

Not at all. For standard items like this jersey, our policy allows for returns within 10 days. So you are unfortunately outside the window. We can definitely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a larger size?
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. An exchange would be perfect, actually. I'd love to get the right one.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange for the next size up. I'm also emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just pack up the jersey that's too tight, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Your new item will ship out as soon as the return is scanned.
That's wonderful. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
